def make_component(index,boundary):
    mu=mean[:]; factor=[0.0]*136
    if boundary:mu[15]=1.0;factor[-1]=.001
    def point(column,sign):
        pre=mu[:]
        if column==15:pre[15]+=sign*.004 if boundary else 0
        bad=pre[15]>1
        return {'column':column,'sign':sign,'weight':0 if column<0 else 1/32,
                'pre_state':pre,'pre_failure_mask':(1<<15) if bad else 0,
                'propagated':not bad,'post_state':None if bad else pre[:],
                'post_failure_mask':0,'model_code':None if bad else 0,
                'voltage_V':None if bad else 3.7,'admitted':not bad,
                'failures':[{'stage':'pre','coordinate':15}] if bad else []}
    nodes=[point(k,s) for k in range(16) for s in (1,-1)]
    nl={'mean_V':3.7,'clean_variance_V2':0,'predictive_variance_V2':1e-6,
        'mean_shift_vs_physical_center_V':0,'mean_shift_vs_production_center_V':0,'variance_shift_V2':0}
    return {'component':index,'saved_mean':mu,'saved_lower_factor_packed_by_row':factor,
            'sigma_V':.001,'center_valid':True,'linear_reference_valid':True,
            'moment_rule_admissible':not boundary,'node_count':32,
            'node_propagations':31 if boundary else 32,'invalid_nodes':int(boundary),
            'pre_invalid_nodes':int(boundary),'post_invalid_nodes':0,'center':point(-1,0),
            'linearized':{'mean_V':3.7,'physical_center_V':3.7,'physical_minus_production_order_V':0,
                'center_order_tolerance_V':1e-12,'clean_sd_V':0,'clean_variance_V2':0,
                'predictive_variance_V2':1e-6,'predictive_sd_from_hypot_V':.001,
                'direct_chain_vs_propagated_factor_max_V':0,'projected_factor_V':[0.0]*16},
            'nonlinear_moments':None if boundary else nl,'nodes':nodes}

        'center_propagations':6,'inadmissible_components':6 if boundary else 0,'snapshots':[]}

        expected[n]=(.01,0,3.7)
        raw['snapshots'].append({'checkpoint_next_index':n,'observation_index':n,'predicted_next_index':n+1,
            'nominal_checkpoint_s':n/35,'dt_s':.01,'current_A':0,'observed_voltage_V':3.7,
            'saved_state_unchanged':True,'log_weights':[-.6931471805599453]*2,
            'components':[make_component(j,boundary) for j in range(2)]})
    return raw,expected
